BOSS BATTLE\nDefeat Minotaur!!
The legend says, a huge monster appeared and\ntormented people around here after the cataclysm.
But one day, a hero sealed the monster underground\nwith the power of the Premiere Gem bestowed by the\nchief god.
And the temple was built to keep the sealing...
We are undercover agents of Resistle.\nI'm the leader, Cipiwon.
Could you lend us the Premiere Gem...?
Why would Resistle people need it?
We, Resistle fight against the menace to the world\nand unknown invaders with magic.
Now, we are facing an urgent need to develop new\nholy gems to defeat the evil dragon...
So, we need to analyze the Premiere Gem quickly.\nWe would appreciate if you...
Not a chance! We must not move the Premiere Gem\nfrom the statue's hand because...
Enough talk, stupid leader!\nLet me handle this!
!! Ruzart! Stop!!
L-Look at that!!
No! The dragon is breaking the seal!
No! The dragon is breaking the seal!
M-Minotaur!\nSo, it was the monster that appeared\nafter the cataclysm!
I never thought the evil dragon is this close...
It must've been waiting for the chance to break\nthe seal when the Premiere Gem is removed from\nthe statue's hand!
!! Please use it!\nMay the chief god protect you!!
The light from the Premiere Gem slowed down\nMinotaur! You might be able to defeat it...!
Put the Premiere Gem back on the hand!
It's amazing...!!\nMinotaur was sealed underground?!
You see? The Premiere Gem is sealing Minotaur.
That's why we must not move it...\nDo you understand?
Hmm, I didn't know that... Understood.\nWe need to call the researchers or find another
way to analyze the Premiere Gem\nwithout moving it...
We'd like to ask for your cooperation when we\nfind the best way to analyze it.\nThanks in advance. See you.
Looks like they are not bad people.\nBy the way, I was wondering why the Premiere Gem\nbegan to shine when you picked it up...
I've never seen this kind of phenomenon before.\nYou must be really the reincarnation of the hero.\n...Yes, you are! Tee hee!
I see. You're going to report it to Pino...\nThen, please say hello to her.\nI hope you will come again.
Is there anything left undone?\n*[ffff64]Your choice makes no difference to the story[ffffff].
Nothing. Let's go out!
Explore the temple a little longer.
